annotation.title_clean: PL n. 177/2024 - Institui a Campanha de Conscientização e Prevenção contra Crimes Cibernéticos, cometidos por meio do uso indevido da inteligência artificial, contra crianças e adolescentes
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 177/2024 - Establishing the Awareness and Prevention Campaign against Cybercrimes committed through the misuse of artificial intelligence against children and adolescents
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados (Dep. Saullo Vianna, União/AM)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian Chamber of Deputies bill PL 177/2024 creating a national awareness and prevention campaign against cybercrimes using misused AI, especially deepfake child sexual content, targeting children and adolescents. It provides educational outreach, civil society partnerships and budgeted implementation. No embodied AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Institutes a national awareness and prevention campaign on AI-enabled cybercrimes against children and adolescents
Educational actions via internet, radio, TV, posters and leaflets, including in schools
Informs that producing or distributing deepfake child sexual imagery is a crime
Executive may partner with civil society organisations
Costs met from existing budget allocations; effective on publication
